---
title: "Mechanisms: why attending an over-demanded school lowers graduation and college assignment"
output: html_document
params:
  data_dir: !r file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE", "~"), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data",
    "finalized_design_v1", "mechanisms")
  out_dir: "output"
---

Tables of the mechanisms section ("Mechanisms") and of its appendix, and the numbers their text quotes. The
children and the 2SLS are those of the outcomes section's Table IV: the children who applied to ninth grade through
SAE in 2016-2021 with the same chance of an offer at an over-demanded school, some offered and some not, with
attendance at an over-demanded school instrumented by the offer, chance-group and application-year fixed effects,
the five characteristics as controls, and heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors. The notebook reads the data
folder (`data_dir`) and writes `tables/` in the output folder (`out_dir`).

```{r setup, error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(fixest)
library(data.table)
stopifnot(packageVersion("fixest") >= "0.13.0")   # versions before 0.13.0 add a factor n/(n-1) to robust SEs

# folders: from `params` when given (rmarkdown::render, or a list named params defined before knitr::knit)
opt <- list(data_dir = file.path(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE", "~"), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data",
                                 "finalized_design_v1", "mechanisms"),
            out_dir = "output")
if (exists("params")) opt[names(params)] <- params
DATA_DIR <- opt$data_dir
TAB_DIR <- file.path(opt$out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(file.path(TAB_DIR, "results"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

setFixest_vcov(all = "hetero")            # robust SEs: OLS with the N/(N-K) factor, as Stata's robust
setFixest_estimation(fixef.rm = "none")   # keep chance groups that hold a single child

controls <- c("GPA8_Z", "ES_MUJER", "PRIORITARIO", "ALTO", "ORIGIN_OD")

# the rows of each table; a row printed on time and ever is the outcome with _OT and with _EVER
reasons <- c(FAILNG = "Failed a year", WDNG = "Withdrew", OTHNG = "Other")
failing <- c(PB_G = "Grades", PB_A = "Attendance alone", PB_U = "Attendance, grades unknown")
school <- c(CLASS_SIZE = "Class size (students)", STUDENT_TEACHER = "Students per teacher at the school",
            DIST_P99 = "Distance to school (km)")
ninth <- c(FAILED_9 = "Failed 9th grade (\\%)", RANK9 = "Percentile at the end of 9th grade",
           CHANGE = "Change in percentile during 9th grade",
           BOTTOM20 = "Ended 9th grade in the bottom fifth of the class (\\%)")
tracks <- c(REG = "Regular", BEA = "BEA", PACE = "PACE", GENERO = "Gender quota")
scores <- c(LM = "Math-Verbal", NEM = "NEM", RANKING = "Ranking")
choices <- c(LIST_PROGRAMS           = "\\quad Programs listed",
             LIST_MEAN_CUTOFF        = "\\quad Mean cutoff percentile of the listed programs",
             LIST_MAX_CUTOFF         = "\\quad Highest cutoff percentile among the listed programs",
             LIST_WEIGHT_NEM_RANKING = "\\quad Weight on NEM and Ranking (\\%)")
app_score <- c(LIST_SCORE              = "\\quad Application score",
               LIST_SCORE_NEM          = "\\quad\\quad NEM part",
               LIST_SCORE_RANKING      = "\\quad\\quad Ranking part",
               LIST_SCORE_EXAMS        = "\\quad\\quad Exams part",
               LIST_SCORE_READING      = "\\quad\\quad\\quad Reading",
               LIST_SCORE_MATH         = "\\quad\\quad\\quad Mathematics",
               LIST_SCORE_HIST_SCIENCE = "\\quad\\quad\\quad History or science")
cutoffs <- c(LIST_MISSED  = "\\quad Listed cutoffs missed (\\%)",
             LIST_REACHED = "\\quad Reached a listed cutoff (\\%)")
access <- c(PACE_SCHOOL = "\\quad Graduated from a PACE school",
            PACE_GRADE  = "\\quad Met PACE's grade rule at her school",
            PACE_BOTH   = "\\quad Met both",
            BEA_GRADE   = "\\quad Met BEA's grade rule at her school")
fail_years <- c(FAIL_YEAR_1 = "Year 1 after entry", FAIL_YEAR_2 = "Year 2 after entry",
                FAIL_YEAR_3 = "Year 3 after entry", FAIL_YEAR_4 = "Year 4 after entry",
                FAIL_YEAR_ANY = "Any of years 1 to 4")

star <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < 0.05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < 0.1, "$^{*}$", "")))
fmt <- function(x, d) sub("^-(0\\.0+)$", "\\1", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # -0.00 prints as 0.00
comma_int <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
row_tex <- function(label, cells) paste0(label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
panel_title <- function(title, ncol = 5) sprintf("\\multicolumn{%d}{l}{\\textit{%s}}\\\\", ncol, title)
ot_ever <- function(k) paste0(k, c("_OT", "_EVER"))
write_tex <- function(lines, file) writeLines(c("% Generated by mechanisms.Rmd", lines), file.path(TAB_DIR, file))

# 2SLS of each outcome in vars on attendance, the offer as the instrument, on the children of d who have it; with
# the mean and the count of the children without an offer. p-values from the normal distribution, as ivreg2's
tsls <- function(d, vars) {
  fit <- feols(.[vars] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d,
               ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))   # 2SLS SEs without the N/(N-K) factor, as ivreg2's robust
  models <- if (inherits(fit, "fixest_multi")) as.list(fit) else list(fit)
  tibble(var = vars,
         est = map_dbl(models, function(m) coef(m)[["fit_D_OD"]]),
         se = map_dbl(models, function(m) se(m)[["fit_D_OD"]]),
         p = map_dbl(models, function(m) 2 * pnorm(-abs(tstat(m)[["fit_D_OD"]]))),
         n = map_dbl(models, nobs),
         n0 = map_dbl(vars, function(v) sum(d$OFFER == 0 & !is.na(d[[v]]))),
         mean = colMeans(d[d$OFFER == 0, vars, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
}

# a row's two lines: the mean without an offer and the estimate with its stars, then the SE, for each outcome in
# vars; x = 100 prints a 0/1 outcome in % and its effects in pp
row_lines <- function(est, label, vars, d = 2, x = 100) {
  e <- est[match(vars, est$var), ]
  c(row_tex(label, c(rbind(fmt(x * e$mean, d), paste0(fmt(x * e$est, d), star(e$p))))),
    row_tex("", c(rbind("", paste0("(", fmt(x * e$se, d), ")")))))
}

# a panel's N: the children without an offer and all children, for each outcome in vars
n_line <- function(est, vars) {
  e <- est[match(vars, est$var), ]
  row_tex("$N$", comma_int(c(rbind(e$n0, e$n))))
}

on_time_ever_header <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  " & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){2-3}\\cmidrule(lr){4-5}",
  " & No offer & 2SLS & No offer & 2SLS\\\\",
  " & mean &  & mean & \\\\",
  " & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\",
  "\\midrule")

# Tables VII to IX: the float around a body file, with caption and note
tex_float <- function(caption, label, body, note, stretch = "1.2", tabcolsep = TRUE) c(
  "\\begin{table}[htp!]", paste0("\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{", stretch, "}"), "\\centering",
  paste0("\\caption{", caption, "}\\label{", label, "}"), "\\small", if (tabcolsep) "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{6pt}",
  paste0("\\input{tables/", body, "}"), "\\par\\smallskip", "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste0("{Notes: ", note, "}"), "\\end{minipage}", "\\end{table}")
```

## Grade stringency

Ignacio Rios's index of how strictly each school grades: the school fixed effects of a regression of tenth-grade
GPA in 2014-2016 on sex, cohort and, within each cohort, natural splines (four degrees of freedom) of the
standardized SIMCE math and reading scores and their product; centered with equal school weights, shrunk by a
scalar empirical Bayes weight, and with the sign reversed (higher is stricter). The calibration keeps publicly
funded schools never private non-subsidized in 2012-2025 with at least 20 students across at least two cohorts.
Each child gets the index of the school she attends in April of the entry year. The text also quotes the
unshrunk index, the index fitted without one cohort, a refit on the math-reading cells where both groups of
schools have at least 20 students, and the offer's effect on whether a child has the index.

```{r grade-stringency-functions}
# the HC0 variance of each centered school effect of an OLS with school indicators and regressors X, without
# the N x J influence matrix
fe_variance <- function(X, e, group, n) {
  J <- length(n)
  xbar <- rowsum(X, group, reorder = FALSE) / n
  Xt <- X - xbar[group, , drop = FALSE]
  Ainv <- chol2inv(chol(crossprod(Xt)))
  V_beta <- Ainv %*% crossprod(Xt * e) %*% Ainv
  B <- rowsum(Xt * e^2, group, reorder = FALSE) / n
  h <- as.numeric(rowsum(e^2, group, reorder = FALSE)) / n^2
  D <- sweep(xbar, 2L, colMeans(xbar), "-")
  B <- sweep(B, 2L, colMeans(B), "-")
  V <- (1 - 2 / J) * h + sum(h) / J^2 + rowSums((D %*% V_beta) * D) - 2 * rowSums((D %*% Ainv) * B)
  pmax(V, 0)
}

spline_cols <- function(yr) c(paste0(rep(c("math", "reading"), each = 4), "_ns", 1:4, "_y", yr),
                              paste0("math_reading_y", yr))

# the index of each school of the calibration sample cal, shrunk and unshrunk
stringency_index <- function(cal) {
  d <- setorder(cal[, .(MRUN, AGNO, RBD, math, reading, female, PROM_GRAL)], RBD, AGNO, MRUN)
  years <- sort(unique(d$AGNO))
  for (yr in years[-1]) set(d, j = paste0("year_", yr), value = as.numeric(d$AGNO == yr))
  for (yr in years) {
    ii <- which(d$AGNO == yr)
    z <- lapply(d[ii, .(math, reading)], function(x) (x - mean(x)) / sd(x))
    basis <- cbind(splines::ns(z$math, df = 4L), splines::ns(z$reading, df = 4L), z$math * z$reading)
    cols <- spline_cols(yr)
    for (k in 1:9) set(d, j = cols[k], value = replace(numeric(nrow(d)), ii, basis[, k]))   # 0 in other cohorts
  }
  rhs <- c("female", paste0("year_", years[-1]), unlist(lapply(years, spline_cols)))
  fit <- feols(as.formula(paste("PROM_GRAL ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "), "| RBD")), d, nthreads = 4L,
               fixef.tol = 1e-10, collin.tol = 1e-10, mem.clean = TRUE, notes = FALSE, warn = FALSE)

  ids <- sort(unique(d$RBD))
  group <- match(d$RBD, ids)
  theta <- unname(fixef(fit)$RBD[as.character(ids)])
  theta <- theta - mean(theta)
  V <- fe_variance(as.matrix(d[, names(coef(fit)), with = FALSE]), resid(fit), group, tabulate(group))
  tau2 <- max(var(theta) - sum(V) / (length(ids) - 1L), 0)
  eb <- tau2 / (tau2 + V) * theta
  data.table(RBD = ids, GRADE_STRINGENCY = -(eb - mean(eb)), GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK = -theta)
}

# the 2SLS of Table IV on the children of d who have the index v
stringency_iv <- function(d, v) {
  d <- d[!is.na(get(v))]
  fit <- feols(.[v] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d, ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))
  b <- coef(fit)[["fit_D_OD"]]
  s <- se(fit)[["fit_D_OD"]]
  tibble(var = v, est = b, se = s, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(b / s)), n = nrow(d), n0 = d[OFFER == 0, .N],
         mean = d[OFFER == 0, mean(get(v))])
}
```

```{r grade-stringency-row}
public <- calibration[COD_DEPE %in% c(1L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 6L) & !EVER_PRIVATE]
cal <- public[RBD %in% public[, .(n = .N, years = uniqueN(AGNO)), by = RBD][n >= 20L & years >= 2L, RBD]]
children <- as.data.table(estimation_sample)

index <- stringency_index(cal)
children[, GRADE_STRINGENCY := index$GRADE_STRINGENCY[match(ENTRY_RBD, index$RBD)]]
children[, GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK := index$GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK[match(ENTRY_RBD, index$RBD)]]
stringency_est <- stringency_iv(children, "GRADE_STRINGENCY")
unshrunk_est <- stringency_iv(children, "GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK")

# whether the child's school has the index, on the offer (OLS)
children[, HAS_STRINGENCY := as.integer(!is.na(GRADE_STRINGENCY))]
availability <- feols(HAS_STRINGENCY ~ OFFER + .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, children)
bind_rows(stringency_est, unshrunk_est)
```

```{r grade-stringency-checks}
# the index fitted without one cohort (schools keep two students), on the children who have all four indexes
for (yr in 2014:2016) {
  fewer <- cal[AGNO != yr]
  fewer <- fewer[RBD %in% fewer[, .N, by = RBD][N >= 2L, RBD]]
  loo <- stringency_index(fewer)
  children[, (paste0("GS_WITHOUT_", yr)) := loo$GRADE_STRINGENCY[match(ENTRY_RBD, loo$RBD)]]
}
loo_children <- children[complete.cases(children[, .(GRADE_STRINGENCY, GS_WITHOUT_2014, GS_WITHOUT_2015,
                                                     GS_WITHOUT_2016)])]
loo_est <- map_dbl(2014:2016, function(yr) stringency_iv(loo_children, paste0("GS_WITHOUT_", yr))$est)

# the refit on the math-reading cells (fifths within each cohort) where both groups of schools have 20 students
support <- copy(cal)
support[, math_cell := pmin(5L, as.integer(ceiling(frank(math, ties.method = "average") / .N * 5))), by = AGNO]
support[, reading_cell := pmin(5L, as.integer(ceiling(frank(reading, ties.method = "average") / .N * 5))), by = AGNO]
cells <- support[, .N, by = .(AGNO, math_cell, reading_cell, OVER_DEMANDED)][
  , .(groups = .N, smallest = min(N)), by = .(AGNO, math_cell, reading_cell)][groups == 2L & smallest >= 20L]
support <- support[cells, on = .(AGNO, math_cell, reading_cell), nomatch = 0]
support <- support[RBD %in% support[, .(n = .N, years = uniqueN(AGNO)), by = RBD][n >= 20L & years >= 2L, RBD]]
common <- stringency_index(support)
children[, GS_COMMON_SUPPORT := common$GRADE_STRINGENCY[match(ENTRY_RBD, common$RBD)]]
support_est <- stringency_iv(children[!is.na(GS_COMMON_SUPPORT) & !is.na(GRADE_STRINGENCY)], "GS_COMMON_SUPPORT")
c(loo_est, support_est$est)
```

# Table VII: college assignment by admission track

Each assigned student counts once, under the track of her first recorded assignment within the horizon (on time,
by the fifth admission process after the application year; ever, by the 2026 process), so the four tracks add up
to Table IV's college seat.

```{r admission-tracks}
track_sample <- estimation_sample
for (h in c("OT", "EVER")) {
  by_process <- if (h == "OT") track_sample$YEAR + 5L else 2026L
  in_horizon <- !is.na(track_sample$FIRST_ASSIGNED_PROCESS) & track_sample$FIRST_ASSIGNED_PROCESS <= by_process
  for (r in names(tracks)) {
    track_sample[[paste0(r, "_", h)]] <- as.integer(in_horizon & track_sample$FIRST_ASSIGNED_TRACK %in% r)
  }
}
track_vars <- c("ASSIGNED", names(tracks))
track_est <- tsls(track_sample, c(paste0(track_vars, "_OT"), paste0(track_vars, "_EVER")))

tracks_tex <- c(
  on_time_ever_header,
  row_lines(track_est, "Total: assigned a college seat", ot_ever("ASSIGNED")),
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Admission tracks"),
  unlist(imap(tracks, function(label, k) row_lines(track_est, label, ot_ever(k)))),
  "\\midrule",
  n_line(track_est, ot_ever("ASSIGNED")),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}")
tracks_note <- paste0(
  "2SLS estimates of the effect of attending an over-demanded school, with the sample and specification of ",
  "Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}; means among students without an offer, in \\%; effects in percentage points. ",
  "The total records assignment through any track. Each assigned student counts once, under the track of her first ",
  "recorded assignment within the horizon. The four track indicators partition total assignment, so their means and ",
  "2SLS effects add to the total before rounding. On time and ever are defined in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. ",
  "The gender quota starts with the 2024 admission process. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in ",
  "parentheses. $^{***}p<0.01$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$.")
write_tex(tracks_tex, "lottery_admission_tracks.tex")
write_tex(tex_float("College Assignment by Admission Track", "tab: lottery admission tracks",
                    "lottery_admission_tracks.tex", tracks_note, tabcolsep = FALSE),
          "results/lottery_admission_tracks.tex")
track_est
```

```{r choices-tex}
  "offer. Effects are in program counts, cutoff percentiles, or percentage points as indicated. A cutoff percentile ",
  "ranks the program's cutoff among the process's programs. On time and ever are defined in ",
  "Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. $^{***}p<0.01$, ",
  "$^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$.")
write_tex(choices_tex, "lottery_application_choices.tex")
write_tex(tex_float("College Application Choices", "tab: lottery application choices",
                    "lottery_application_choices.tex", choices_note),
          "results/lottery_application_choices.tex")
```

```{r scores-tex}
# a row of Table IX: the mean without an offer, the estimate and the N, on time and ever, then the SEs
score_lines <- function(est, label, vars, d = 3) {
  e <- est[match(vars, est$var), ]
  c(row_tex(label, c(rbind(fmt(e$mean, d), paste0(fmt(e$est, d), star(e$p)), comma_int(e$n)))),
    row_tex("", c(rbind("", paste0("(", fmt(e$se, d), ")"), ""))))
}
scores_tex <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  " & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){2-4}\\cmidrule(lr){5-7}",
  " & No offer & 2SLS & $N$ & No offer & 2SLS & $N$\\\\",
  " & mean &  &  & mean &  & \\\\",
  " & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4) & (5) & (6)\\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Panel A. Individual admission scores (SD)", 7),
  unlist(map2(score_vars, scores, function(k, label) score_lines(score_est, label, ot_ever(k)))),
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Panel B. Application score at the listed programs (SD)", 7),
  unlist(imap(app_score, function(label, k) score_lines(list_est, label, ot_ever(k)))),
  paste0("% ", c("\\midrule", panel_title("Panel C. Cutoff attainment at listed programs", 7),
                 unlist(imap(cutoffs, function(label, k) score_lines(list_est, label, ot_ever(k), d = 2))))),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}")

official <- estimation_sample$SCORE_NEM_RANKING_EVER_OFFICIAL   # missing without both NEM and Ranking ever
first_list <- list_est[match(ot_ever("LIST_PROGRAMS"), list_est$var), ]
scores_note <- paste0(
  "2SLS estimates as in Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}; means among students without an offer. Panel A uses ",
  "students with both compulsory exam scores for Math-Verbal, and graduates with both NEM and Ranking for those ",
  "rows. NEM and Ranking are official for ", comma_int(sum(official, na.rm = TRUE)), " of the ",
  comma_int(sum(!is.na(official))), " students ever, and computed from school records for the rest. Panel B uses ",
  "the applicants and first lists in Table~\\ref{tab: lottery application choices}; Panel B averages scores and ",
  "components over listed programs. Panel A is in SD of each score; Panel B is in SD of published application ",
  "scores. Parts share the total's centering and scale and add to it before rounding. Panel B includes ",
  comma_int(first_list$n0[1]), " students without an offer on time, ", comma_int(first_list$n0[2]), " ever. ",
  "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. $^{***}p<0.01$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$.")
write_tex(scores_tex, "lottery_admission_scores.tex")
write_tex(tex_float("College Admission Scores", "tab: lottery scores", "lottery_admission_scores.tex", scores_note,
                    stretch = "1.0"),
          "results/lottery_admission_scores.tex")
```

# Table X: PACE and BEA

PACE's school condition (grades 11 and 12 at schools on the PACE list, graduating from one), PACE's grade rule
among her school's graduates, both, and BEA's grade rule; each row is 0 for a student who does not graduate
within the horizon.

```{r pace-bea}
access_est <- tsls(estimation_sample, c(paste0(names(access), "_OT"), paste0(names(access), "_EVER")))

pace_tex <- c(
  on_time_ever_header,
  panel_title("Panel A. PACE"),
  unlist(map(c("PACE_GRADE", "PACE_SCHOOL", "PACE_BOTH"), function(k) {   # the paper's order: the grade rule first
    row_lines(access_est, access[[k]], ot_ever(k))
  })),
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Panel B. BEA"),
  row_lines(access_est, access[["BEA_GRADE"]], ot_ever("BEA_GRADE")),
  "\\midrule",
  n_line(access_est, ot_ever("PACE_GRADE")),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(pace_tex, "pace_bea_access.tex")
access_est
```

# Appendix Table D.3: PACE's academic rules by admission process

From the official guides of 2021-2023, Resolution 3625 of June 29, 2023, and the 2025-2026 guides.

```{r pace-rules}
pace_rules_tex <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]",
  "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.25}\\centering",
  "\\caption{PACE Academic Requirements by Admission Process}\\label{tab: pace annual rules}",
  "\\small\\begin{tabular}{ccccc}\\toprule",
  "Admission & Graduation & Within-school & Absolute Ranking & Valid admission \\\\",
  "process & cohort & top share & alternative & processes \\\\\\midrule",
  "2021 & 2020 & 15\\% & $\\geq 710$ & 2021 \\\\",
  "2022 & 2021 & 15\\% & $\\geq 749$ & 2022 \\\\",
  "2023 & 2022 & 20\\% & $\\geq 863$ & 2023--2024 \\\\",
  "2024 & 2023 & 20\\% & $\\geq 851$ & 2024--2025 \\\\",
  "2025 & 2024 & 25\\% & $\\geq 815$ & 2025--2026 \\\\",
  "2026 & 2025 & 25\\% & $\\geq 830$ & 2026--2027 \\\\",
  "\\bottomrule\\end{tabular}\\par\\smallskip",
  "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste0("Notes: Each row describes a newly graduating cohort. The academic requirement is the within-school ",
         "percentile of the official Ranking score or the absolute-score alternative. Scores use the 150--850 scale ",
         "in 2021--2022 and the approximately 100--1000 scale from 2023. Students must also attend grades 11 and 12 ",
         "at a participating school and graduate from one, and take reading, mathematics (Mathematics 1 from 2023), ",
         "and an elective in history/social sciences or sciences. A previous cohort can retain eligibility in the ",
         "following process, subject to exam completion and the one-use condition, without being reassessed under ",
         "the new cohort's academic threshold."),
  paste0("Sources: Annual official guides for 2021--2023 \\citep{paceRules2021,paceRules2022,paceRules2023}, ",
         "Resolution 3625 of June 29, 2023 for admission 2024 \\citep{paceRules2024}, and the 2025--2026 guides ",
         "\\citep{paceRules2025,paceRules2026}."),
  "\\end{minipage}\\end{table}")
write_tex(pace_rules_tex, "appendix_pace_rules.tex")
```

# The numbers the text quotes

Written as LaTeX macros: shares are plain numbers (the text adds the percent sign) and effects are absolute values
where the text gives their direction in words. The text's footnote on PACE schools compares the share of the
over-demanded schools with a 12th grade on the PACE list, each school year, with that of the other publicly funded
schools with a 12th grade; the appendix counts the students holding a PACE or a BEA seat ever, and those of them
meeting the matching row of Table X.

```{r text-numbers}
pace_share <- schools %>%
  group_by(YEAR, OVER_DEMANDED) %>%
  summarise(share = 100 * mean(ON_PACE_LIST), .groups = "drop")
od_range <- fmt(range(pace_share$share[pace_share$OVER_DEMANDED]), 1)
other_range <- fmt(range(pace_share$share[!pace_share$OVER_DEMANDED]), 1)

all_est <- bind_rows(graduation_est, school_est, ninth_est, track_est, score_est, list_est, access_est, fail_est)
b <- setNames(all_est$est, all_est$var)       # the 2SLS estimates
m <- setNames(all_est$mean, all_est$var)      # the means without an offer
n_obs <- setNames(all_est$n, all_est$var)
pp <- function(x) fmt(abs(100 * x), 2)        # an effect on a 0/1 outcome, in pp
pct <- function(x) fmt(100 * x, 2)            # a mean of a 0/1 outcome, in %
bea_drop <- -(b[["BEA_GRADE_OT"]] / m[["BEA_GRADE_OT"]])   # BEA's grade rule: the fall over its mean
failed_ninth <- ninth_sample$FAILED_9 == 1L
seats <- with(estimation_sample, c(
  PACESeatHolders = sum(PACE_SEAT_EVER == 1L), PACESeatMeeting = sum(PACE_SEAT_EVER == 1L & PACE_BOTH_EVER == 1L),
  BEASeatHolders = sum(BEA_SEAT_EVER == 1L), BEASeatMeeting = sum(BEA_SEAT_EVER == 1L & BEA_GRADE_EVER == 1L)))

macros <- c(
  DistanceCapKm           = fmt(cap, 0),
  FailedYearOnTime        = pp(b[["FAILNG_OT"]]),
  FailedYearEver          = pp(b[["FAILNG_EVER"]]),
  FailedYearOnTimeMean    = pct(m[["FAILNG_OT"]]),
  FailedYearEverMean      = pct(m[["FAILNG_EVER"]]),
  WithdrewEver            = fmt(100 * b[["WDNG_EVER"]], 2),   # with its sign: the text gives no direction
  GradesOnTime            = pp(b[["PB_G_OT"]]),
  GradesEver              = pp(b[["PB_G_EVER"]]),
  AttendanceUnknownOnTime = pp(b[["PB_U_OT"]]),
  AttendanceUnknownEver   = pp(b[["PB_U_EVER"]]),
  ClassSize               = fmt(abs(b[["CLASS_SIZE"]]), 2),
  ClassSizeShare          = fmt(100 * (b[["CLASS_SIZE"]] / m[["CLASS_SIZE"]]), 2),
  ClassSizeMean           = fmt(m[["CLASS_SIZE"]], 2),
  StudentsPerTeacher      = fmt(abs(b[["STUDENT_TEACHER"]]), 2),
  StudentsPerTeacherShare = fmt(100 * (b[["STUDENT_TEACHER"]] / m[["STUDENT_TEACHER"]]), 2),
  StudentsPerTeacherMean  = fmt(m[["STUDENT_TEACHER"]], 2),
  FailedNinth             = pp(b[["FAILED_9"]]),
  FailedNinthMean         = pct(m[["FAILED_9"]]),
  StartPercentileLower    = fmt(b[["CHANGE"]] - b[["RANK9"]], 2),   # the start of 9th grade: the change less the end
  PercentileChange        = fmt(abs(b[["CHANGE"]]), 2),
  PercentileEnd           = fmt(abs(b[["RANK9"]]), 2),
  BottomFifth             = pp(b[["BOTTOM20"]]),
  BottomFifthMean         = pct(m[["BOTTOM20"]]),
  BottomFifthAmongFailed  = fmt(100 * mean(ninth_sample$BOTTOM20[failed_ninth] == 1L), 1),
  RegularOnTime           = pp(b[["REG_OT"]]),
  PACEOnTime              = pp(b[["PACE_OT"]]),
  BEAOnTime               = pp(b[["BEA_OT"]]),
  BEAEver                 = pp(b[["BEA_EVER"]]),
  PACEEver                = pp(b[["PACE_EVER"]]),
  ExamScoreShare          = fmt(100 * n_obs[["SCORE_LM_OT"]] / nrow(estimation_sample), 0),
  GradeScoreShare         = fmt(100 * n_obs[["SCORE_NEM_OT"]] / nrow(estimation_sample), 0),
  MathVerbalOnTime        = fmt(abs(b[["SCORE_LM_OT"]]), 3),
  NEMOnTime               = fmt(abs(b[["SCORE_NEM_OT"]]), 3),
  RankingOnTime           = fmt(abs(b[["SCORE_RANKING_OT"]]), 3),
  ApplicationScoreOnTime  = fmt(abs(b[["LIST_SCORE_OT"]]), 3),
  RankingPartOnTime       = fmt(abs(b[["LIST_SCORE_RANKING_OT"]]), 3),
  NEMPartOnTime           = fmt(abs(b[["LIST_SCORE_NEM_OT"]]), 3),
  ExamsPartOnTime         = fmt(abs(b[["LIST_SCORE_EXAMS_OT"]]), 3),
  PACEGradeOnTime         = pp(b[["PACE_GRADE_OT"]]),
  BEAGradeOnTime          = pp(b[["BEA_GRADE_OT"]]),
  PACEGradeMean           = pct(m[["PACE_GRADE_OT"]]),
  BEAGradeMean            = pct(m[["BEA_GRADE_OT"]]),
  PACEGradeDecline        = fmt(-100 * (b[["PACE_GRADE_OT"]] / m[["PACE_GRADE_OT"]]), 1),
  BEAGradeDecline         = fmt(100 * bea_drop, 1),
  BEAGradeDeclineFraction = fmt(bea_drop, 3),
  BEAAssignedMean         = pct(m[["BEA_OT"]]),
  BEAImpliedDecline       = fmt(bea_drop * 100 * m[["BEA_OT"]], 2),   # in pp of BEA assignment on time
  PACESchoolOnTime        = pp(b[["PACE_SCHOOL_OT"]]),
  PACESchoolMean          = pct(m[["PACE_SCHOOL_OT"]]),
  PACEListODMin           = od_range[1],
  PACEListODMax           = od_range[2],
  PACEListOtherMin        = other_range[1],
  PACEListOtherMax        = other_range[2],
  PACEBothOnTime          = pp(b[["PACE_BOTH_OT"]]),
  PACEBothMean            = pct(m[["PACE_BOTH_OT"]]),
  PACEBothDecline         = fmt(-100 * (b[["PACE_BOTH_OT"]] / m[["PACE_BOTH_OT"]]), 0),
  FailAnyYear             = pp(b[["FAIL_YEAR_ANY"]]),
  FailFirstYear           = pp(b[["FAIL_YEAR_1"]]),
  comma_int(seats))
write_tex(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\Mech%s}{%s}", names(macros), macros), "mechanisms_text_macros.tex")
macros
```
